text:
Jon Park: Heads-up — SprintBank is in a decision window with their board next Tue. They need answers on pricing carve-outs for high-throughput inference, KMS attestation, and network peering by EOD tomorrow. Can we align owners?

Alice Chen: Ack. I told them we could provide a formal price scoping doc by EOD if SE and finance confirm numbers.

Mike Rivera: I can run updated qps/cost numbers. Need the expected token/query profile (batch vs streaming). Alice, can you paste their workload sample?

Alice Chen: Copied below (from customer email):
```
- 3k reqs/min at peak
- avg prompt 120 tokens, generation 150 tokens
- 80% streaming low-latency paths, 20% batch async
```

Mike Rivera: Thanks. I'll model with Dedicated 4xA100 during peak + burst to Hosted. Expect ~22% lower unit cost with prefix caching. Will share the spreadsheet in 60m.

Tara Singh: On KMS attestation — SprintBank's security team requested HSM-backed key control and an attestation letter for our private deployment. We have a standard attestation template but need legal + infra sign-off. @Samir can you confirm timeline?

Samir Patel: Legal can sign standard attestation, but HSM wording needs product/infra confirmation. @Olivia can infra confirm we can support HSM-backed keys in their VPC before board? If not, we can offer mitigations in writing.

Olivia Gomez: Short answer: we can support HSM (Cloud KMS + customer-managed keys) in Private, but for an on-prem HSM attestation we need an extra week for audit docs. For VPC with CMK we can produce an attestation letter today referencing our KMS integration and rotation policy.

Jon Park: Good — so propose we give them: 1) pricing scoping doc (Mike), 2) KMS attestation for VPC/CMK (Samir + Olivia), 3) network peering runbook + timeline (Infra). Can we confirm owners + ETA by 1600 PT?

Mike Rivera: Owner: me — pricing spreadsheet draft 1500 PT.

Olivia Gomez: Owner: infra-side for KMS wording and peering runbook. Will post draft attestation and runbook snippets by 1600 PT.

Samir Patel: Legal will review attestation and provide final signed PDF by EOD tomorrow if wording is within standard templates.

Alice Chen: I'll coordinate a short exec bridge for Wed AM with their CTO + our VP Sales and CISO if they need sign-off after receiving docs. Tentative time 09:30 PT.

Jon Park: Please add meeting invite if docs are ready. Also need an internal one-pager that explains fallback: if HSM on-prem is delayed, we commit to a formal timeline + contractual remedy. Olivia, can you sketch that fallback verbiage?

Olivia Gomez: Yes — I'll include a fallback section: timeline, mitigation (customer-managed KMS in cloud + audit log exports), and compensation language for SLA misses. Draft in channel by 1600.

Tara Singh: I'll prep a short security summary (controls + SOC2/KMS details) for the board pack. Will add to the thread when ready.

ops-bot: reminder: "Delivery doc template" created at https://redwood.internal/docs/delivery-template — please attach to the thread.

Alice Chen: Attachments: pricing spreadsheet (draft), workload sample email, meeting invite (tentative).

Jon Park: Thanks all. If anything blocks getting legal sign-off, flag here immediately and DM me. :thumbsup:

Mike Rivera: Uploaded spreadsheet v0.1 — links + assumptions in the sheet.

Olivia Gomez: KMS attestation draft posted (see doc link). Added fallback paragraph and contact for infra verification.

Samir Patel: Reviewed attestation, suggested one minor clause change (export control wording). Pushed suggestion; will finalize after Olivia's tweak.

Alice Chen: SprintBank replied: "This is perfect — we'll wait for the attestation and final price. Board meeting is Tue EOD."

Jon Park: Ok team — final push. Target: final price + signed attestation into customer inbox by COB tomorrow. Meeting tentatively Wed AM stands as backup for exec Q/A.

Mike Rivera: On it.

Tara Singh: On security summary.

Samir Patel: Legal on standby.

Olivia Gomez: Infra on standby.

Alice Chen: I'll update the customer after we send docs.

Jon Park: Closing loop later tonight with status. Thanks.
